procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
HKG 3393 was represented by Bernice Pang.
ISV 2985 was represented by Quinten Opstaele.
facts: Right after the warning signal to race F2, wind speed was 15 knt.
HKG 3393 was stationary, on a close-hauled course on starboard tack. ISV 2985 sailing on a reaching course on port tack, passing in front of HKG 3393 by less than 1 hull length.
When ISV 2985 was passing HKG 3393, she bore away to a downwind course, and a second later she lost control of her boat, gybed and made contact with HKG 3393.
Contact occurred between ISV 2985's bowsprit and HKG 3393's third aft of the hull on her starboard side.
There was a damage to HKG 3393 boat, 30cm crack through the lamination. The boat was taking in water.
ISV 2985 took One-Turn Penalty, then sailed and finished that race.
HKG 3393 sailed in that race and finished in 35th place.
conclusions: ISV 2985 to windward failed to keep clear of HKG 3393 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
ISV 2985 did not avoid contact with HKG 3393 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).

Since ISV 2985 was not racing but was sailing in the racing area and intended to race, and broke RRS 14 causing serious damage, the preamble to RRS Part 2 permits the protest committee to penalize her.
It was not reasonably possible for HKG 3393, the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with ISV 2985 when it became clear that ISV 3393 was not keeping clear. HKG 3393 did not break RRS 14(a).

HKG 3393’s score in race F2 was made significantly worse through no fault of her own by physical damage because of the action of ISV 2985 that was breaking RRS 11 and 14(a). And the ISV 2985 was penalized. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(2) are met.
decision: ISV 2985 is DSQ in race F2. The penalty will apply to the race sailed nearest in time to the incident, in accordance with RRS 60.5(c).

Redress is given to HKG 3393. HKG 3393 is to be scored in race F3 points equal to the average, rounded to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), of her points in all races in the Final series, except race F3. No other boats' score shall change.
